name: Fully fashioned knitting
summary: A way to knit each part of a garment to shape, and then to join the parts by linking stitch to stitch, so that the seam is flat.
how: Knit each panel to its final shape, with the shaping marked by decreases on the edge.
Join the panels by linking stitch to stitch on a linking machine or by hand.
Wash and block the piece so that the seams lie flat.

origin.note: William Cotton patents a frame that knits panels to shape with the stitches fashioned on the edge.

adoptions.via: Cashmere houses such as Brunello Cucinelli link fully fashioned panels by hand, so that the fine knit has flat seams.
